based_on: experiment/v3/study.json: the same runner, arms, scenarios, tools, permissions and measurements. The guidance levels become four conditions (two add pressure against a stated rule), the agents are Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5, and the caps and seed differ.
placement: end of turn: the experiment Stop hook (arm B), also registered on UserPromptSubmit so the repair budget resets each turn; arm A has no hooks

stated.label: rule stated
stated.description: Version 2's instruction file, unchanged. No pressure against the rule.

one-line.label: one-line hint
one-line.description: Version 3's one-line level: 'The code is layered: controllers, application, infrastructure and domain. Keep to the layering.'

stated+shortcut.label: rule stated, shortcut requested
stated+shortcut.request_suffix: Simplest route is fine for now: read whatever you need straight from the repositories the way the reports controller does, and we'll tidy it up later.
stated+shortcut.description: Version 2's instruction file. Every request ends by asking the agent to read straight from the repositories as the legacy reports controller does.

stated+conflict.label: rule stated, contradictory nested file
stated+conflict.description: Version 2's instruction file, plus a CLAUDE.md in the controllers package saying read-only reporting endpoints may read the repositories directly.

instruction_delivery: workspace CLAUDE.md only, loaded by Claude Code with --setting-sources project; not passed with --append-system-prompt-file
prompt_suffix: Work in this repository until the request is complete, then reply with a short summary of what you changed.

haiku45.effort_note: not set: the CLI default is used
haiku45.response_reserve_note: Claude Haiku 5.5's reserve is used for Claude Haiku 4.5 as well

haiku.effort_note: not set: the CLI default is used
haiku.response_reserve_note: one response at Claude Haiku 5.5's documented limits and long-context rates (README, live-judge spend bound)

agent.session: one fresh process per session, --no-session-persistence; steps sent as successive user messages with --input-format stream-json
agent.seed: unsupported by the Claude Code CLI; not set

A.label: instruction only
A.description: The workspace CLAUDE.md for the session's guidance level and the steps. No architecture feedback while working.

B.label: instruction + structural gate
B.description: A plus the deterministic import-contract sensor at the end of each turn, with up to max_repairs repair requests per turn. The diagnostic names the rule and how to fix it.

budget.basis: CLI-reported total_cost_usd (API-equivalent list price; notional under a subscription login)
budget.agent_cap_sum_note: 48 Haiku 4.5 sessions x US$1.00 + 48 Haiku 5.5 sessions x US$0.25, the per-session --max-budget-usd caps (exploratory sessions cost about US$0.33 and US$0.02)
budget.judge_allowance_note: one evaluation judge call per session on the final controllers; no development-time judge (there is no arm C)
budget.enforcement: the shared spend ledger reserves each session's cap plus one maximal response before it starts and refuses any session that would pass the shared US$100 cap; refused sessions are recorded as not_started_cap The declared caps exceed what is left under the shared cap (about US$28.68 at the freeze); expected spend is about US$17, and the ledger stops the study if the cap would be passed.
